t: On being given another chance without asking
a: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى يَقْبَلُ ٱلتَّوْبَةَ عَنْ عِبَادِهِۦ وَيَعْفُوا۟ عَنِ ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتِ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا تَفْعَلُونَ
p: Wa huwa-lladhī yaqbalu-t-tawbata ʿan ʿibādihi wa yaʿfū ʿani-s-sayyi'āti wa yaʿlamu mā tafʿalūn.
m: And it is He who accepts repentance from His servants and pardons misdeeds, and He knows what you do.
uc: Recitation by Mishari Rashid al-Afasy, via Quran.com
